programs.name: sugeom
programs.purpose: Fill trace geometry headers from SPS receiver, source, and relation files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGEOM - Fill up geometry in trace headers.

params.name: rps
params.description: Receiver SPS file; required unless prefix supplies its name.

params.name: sps
params.description: Source SPS file; required unless prefix supplies its name.

params.name: xps
params.description: Relation SPS file; required unless prefix supplies its name.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Prefix used to construct missing SPS filenames.

params.name: ibin
params.description: Inline bin size; zero disables CDP calculation.

params.name: dt
params.description: Checked for presence but not used in geometry calculations.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Geometry uses mixed float and double arithmetic, sqrt and pow, and conversions to integer headers. SPS point matching compares floating-point values. The dt variable is checked despite its initialization needing particular attention when porting.
programs.difficulty_reason: It parses three fixed-format SPS files and maintains trace-to-relation matching state.

test_cases.description: Revision 2 geometry using a prepared matching SPS fixture.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 > in.su && sugeom rps=receiver.r sps=source.s xps=relation.x rev=2 ibin=12.5 < in.su > out.su

test_cases.description: Revision 0 geometry and prefix-derived filenames using a prepared matching SPS fixture.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 > in.su && sugeom prefix=survey rev=0 verbose=1 dt=0.004 < in.su > out.su

programs.name: sugeomcsv
programs.purpose: Assign or create trace headers from CSV or fixed-format geometry records.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGEOMCSV - 3D/2D land/OBotm geometry from Comma Separated or fixed text.

params.name: ufile
params.description: File containing C_SU options; command selects command-line options.

params.name: rtype
params.default: computed: csv if rfile ends in csv, otherwise fixed
params.description: Input record format, csv or fixed.

params.name: names
params.description: Input field names; required on command line when ufile=command.

params.name: setid
params.description: Select input records by leading identifier.

params.name: match
params.description: Header keys used to match records; required on command line when ufile=command.

params.name: nicerecord
params.description: Controls skipping unsuitable records at the start of the file.

params.name: maxrecords
params.description: Maximum record allocation; zero counts input records.

params.name: unrepeat
params.description: Controls handling of repeated record numbers.

params.name: scalco
params.description: Coordinate scaling factor, stored with reversed sign in the header.

params.name: scalel
params.description: Elevation scaling factor, stored with reversed sign in the header.

params.name: missing
params.description: Missing matches halt by default; delete or pass selects another action.

params.name: action
params.description: Default replaces headers; add and subtract modify existing values.

params.name: create
params.description: Create traces from records; accepts a count or all.

params.name: spikes
params.description: Time-amplitude pairs for created traces, or an input trace number to replicate.

params.name: tolr
params.description: Undocumented tolerance used to quantize matching values.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Matching quantizes double values using a tolerance initialized from float; header conversion uses rounding including lrint, whose result depends on the floating-point rounding mode. Several option pointers are tested after unchecked getparstring calls, so initialization behavior matters.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program is over 3,000 lines and combines several record formats, matching, sorting, and trace creation.

test_cases.description: Replace matched header values from a CSV fixture.
test_cases.command: printf '1,100\n2,200\n' > geom.csv && suplane nt=64 ntr=2 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sugeomcsv rfile=geom.csv ufile=command names=cdp,selev match=cdp scalel=1 > out.su

test_cases.description: Add matched values and pass unmatched traces.
test_cases.command: printf '1,10\n' > geom.csv && suplane nt=64 ntr=2 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sugeomcsv rfile=geom.csv ufile=command names=cdp,selev match=cdp action=add missing=pass scalel=1 > out.su

programs.name: sukeycount
programs.purpose: Count consecutive traces with the same selected header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKEYCOUNT - sukeycount writes a count of a selected key

params.name: key
params.description: One header key; a positional key is also accepted.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print argument diagnostics in the positional-key path.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Floating-point header values are compared for exact inequality. Empty input dereferences a null type pointer after the trace loop.
programs.difficulty_reason: It compares one header per trace and prints counts at changes.

test_cases.description: Count runs of integer CDP values.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 c=2 | sukeycount key=cdp

test_cases.description: Count runs of a float header using the positional-key form.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sushw key=d1 a=0.004 b=0.001 | sukeycount d1

programs.name: sulcthw
programs.purpose: Translate and rotate source and receiver coordinate headers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SULCTHW - Linear Coordinate Transformation of Header Words
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Parameters are parsed as float then promoted to double; rotations use sin and cos with an approximate degrees-to-radians constant and update coordinates sequentially. Integer rounding and scaler selection affect results. The elevation output multiplier is calculated from scalco rather than scalel.
programs.difficulty_reason: It applies a fixed coordinate transformation independently to each trace.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx,gx a=100,200 b=10,10 | sulcthw xt=12.5 yt=-3 zt=4 > out.su
suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx,sy,gx,gy a=100,20,200,40 | sulcthw xr=10 yr=20 zr=30 > out.su

programs.name: sulhead
programs.purpose: Update trace headers from rows of an ASCII column file matched by a header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SULHEAD - Load information from an ascii column file into HEADERS based

params.name: key
params.description: Header names for columns. Although code assigns cdp when omitted, it leaves the column count at zero, so omission is unsafe.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: File values are read as float and converted with (int)(value+0.5), which treats negative values asymmetrically. The mc range check uses an impossible conjunction, omitted key leaves indexes uninitialized, and the double-header switch case falls through to an error.
programs.difficulty_reason: It loads a table and searches all rows for each trace.

test_cases.description: Match CDP and update source coordinates, including an unmatched trace.
test_cases.command: printf '1 100\n2 200\n' > columns.txt && suplane nt=64 ntr=3 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sulhead cf=columns.txt key=cdp,sx mc=1 verbose=1 > out.su
printf '10 1\n20 2\n' > columns.txt && suplane nt=64 ntr=2 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | sulhead cf=columns.txt key=ep,cdp mc=2 > out.su

programs.name: sunearcsv
programs.purpose: Copy header values from the nearest eligible Q-file point to each trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUNEARCSV - Assign Trace Key Values From Nearest Q-file Record.

params.name: dimx
params.description: X search dimension; at least one dimension is required.

params.name: typex
params.description: X distance and extent mode; requires dimx.

params.name: typey
params.description: Y distance and extent mode; requires dimy.

params.name: typer
params.description: R distance and extent mode; requires dimr.

params.name: typea
params.description: A distance and extent mode; requires dima.

params.name: typeb
params.description: B distance and extent mode; requires dimb.

params.name: typec
params.description: C distance and extent mode; requires dimc.

params.name: typed
params.description: D distance and extent mode; requires dimd.

params.name: typee
params.description: E distance and extent mode; requires dime.

params.name: typef
params.description: F distance and extent mode; requires dimf.

params.name: keyp
params.description: Profile ordering key or asis, dist, none; explicitly use none when either X or Y dimension is missing.

params.name: okeys
params.description: Q-file keys copied to trace headers.

params.name: nopoint
params.description: Error on no eligible point; zero passes the trace.

params.name: sfunc
params.description: Select tree or brute-force search; negative values cross-check against brute force.

params.name: sdist
params.description: Initial search distance for cycle search.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Nearest-point distances accumulate squared double differences; sqrt and profile geometry can vary across platforms, and ties depend on comparison and ordering. Default keyp and okeys allocate three bytes before copying the four-byte string cdp including its terminator, causing buffer overflows.
programs.difficulty_reason: It builds and searches a multidimensional k-d tree with several extent and profile modes.

test_cases.description: Search a prepared Q-file in one dimension with brute force.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 > in.su && sunearcsv qin=points.csv dimx=sx keyp=none okeys=cdp sfunc=0 < in.su > out.su

test_cases.description: Cross-check tree search against brute force with relative bounds.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 > in.su && sunearcsv qin=points.csv dimx=sx dimy=sy typex=2 minx=-100 maxx=100 keyp=dist okeys=cdp sfunc=-2 sdist=20 smult=2 nopoint=0 < in.su > out.su
